messages:
Anna: Heads-up — PR #2456 is blocked by a flaky CI hang on the macOS graphics shard. Don't merge yet; asking for quick eyes and a rerun plan. Logs below:

Anna: ```
FAIL test_render_timing.py::TestRender::test_timeout
Timeout after 120s waiting for render_worker to respond
Stack: render_worker.cpp:412 vkQueueSubmit -> wait_for_fence -> sleep
Last logs: 'submitted frame 512', no response for 2m
```

Priya: Which shard / pool is this happening on? Can we do a targeted rerun? @Taylor for mac infra

Sam: It's mac-matrix, shard=7 (mac-host-23). Reproduced 2/4 runs locally in CI, looks like a host-side GPU hang, not a deterministic test failure.

Taylor: I can take a look now. Prefer targeted rerun of shard=7 first, then full mac matrix if it persists.

Anna: Plan: rerun shard=7 once. If still flaky, rerun on a different mac pool (mac-pool-b) and hold merge until we get 2 consecutive greens per policy. @CI-bot queue targeted rerun for shard=7 please.

CI-bot: Buildkite: Queued targeted rerun for PR #2456 (shard=7). Attempt 1/3 started — https://buildkite.example/runs/98765

Maya: :eyes: I'll watch logs. If it hangs again we should capture a core or extra debug (gcore) from the host.

CI-bot: Attempt 1 finished — FAILURE (hang). Hang point: render_worker.cpp:412 waiting on vkQueueSubmit. Partial stack attached to build logs.

Taylor: Same hang signature as prior incident. Most likely host GPU driver hiccup. Suggest rerunning on mac-pool-b to rule out host flake.

Sam: We have capacity on mac-pool-b. CI-bot, can you schedule the rerun on pool=mac-pool-b? Suggested command: `/bk retry --pr 2456 --shard 7 --pool mac-pool-b`

CI-bot: Buildkite: Scheduled rerun on pool=mac-pool-b. Attempt 2/3 started — https://buildkite.example/runs/98766

CI-bot: Attempt 2 finished — PASS ✅ (shard=7 all tests green)

Anna: Nice — looks host-specific. Per merge policy I'll hold until we have two green runs. Kicking off one more quick run now.

Priya: LGTM to merge once we have 2 greens. Anna, ping me when ready and I'll approve.

Anna: Also opened a small follow-up PR to add extended timeout logging in the render tests to capture more context if this recurs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2460

Taylor: Good call. @CI-bot, please add label `flaky:mac-render` on PR #2456 so it's tracked for postmortem if it recurs.

CI-bot: Label applied: flaky:mac-render. Test flake recorded in flake tracker.

Anna: Adding a short comment on the PR describing the rerun/resolution and marking merge hold until second green. Pinging reviewers for final approval.

Sam: I'll file an infra ticket to check host health and GPU driver telemetry for mac-host-23. Linking here once created.

Priya: Thanks everyone. Standby for my approval after the second green run.

Taylor: Thanks — feel free to merge after 2 consecutive greens and an approval. :thumbsup:
